subject: Rebaseline request: ownership reset and MAP risk ledger
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixhealth.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alicia.park@helixhealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close timeline check-in — June 30 target

Maya —

Quick note from procurement: we are running into a legal review queue and internal budget committee that will likely push our final PO sign-off past the June 30 date we discussed. I wanted to flag this early so we can adjust the MAP rather than scramble later.

Current constraints:
- Legal review estimated completion: ~2 weeks
- Procurement needs updated final SOW and pricing appendix from your side (they say the version we have is missing indemnity clause language)

Can we set up a short call to rebaseline milestones? If possible, please propose a new mutual action plan with clear acceptance windows and any conditional fallbacks. Alicia is copied — she is leading procurement on our side.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior PM, Partnerships — Helix Health
[Attachment: ProcurementHold.pdf (PDF)]

From: maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixhealth.com>, alicia.park@helixhealth.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline check-in — June 30 target

Liam / Alicia —

Thanks for the heads-up. Appreciate the early flag — we want to avoid a last-minute scramble too. Proposed immediate steps from our side:

1) Short call this week to confirm the exact legal open points (15–20 min).
2) We will publish an updated MAP (v3) that replaces the June 30 milestone with a conditional go-live window and explicit acceptance gates (SIT, UAT, final sign-off).
3) Provide a redline to the SOW addressing indemnity and the specific procurement asks by EOD tomorrow.

I am attaching a risk-ledger template we use for MAPs (close-runway-risk-log.csv) — we will populate it and share with you before the call so procurement can mark hard blockers vs. soft constraints.

Proposed call times: Tue 06/21 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 06/22 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works best?

Action owners: Karhtik (sales engineering) will confirm technical acceptance windows; Neha (customer success) will outline the support plan for UAT.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: close-runway-risk-log.csv (CSV)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline check-in — June 30 target

Looping in notes from our side after a quick internal triage:

- Technical readiness: model onboarding and infra setup are clear — we can move quickly once PO and SOW are signed.
- Risk: if procurement extends beyond 3 weeks, we need to queue a capacity slot (we can reserve a soft hold, but that incurs a nominal retention fee).
- Contingency: propose a phased acceptance approach — sandbox enablement within 5 business days of PO, limited-production (pilot) 10 business days after that, full go-live aligned with SLA acceptance window.

I'll prepare a succinct MAP-v3 (action items, owners, deadlines) and share for approval. Also recommend we have a single procurement-facing SOW redline to avoid back-and-forth.

—Karthik
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procure@helixhealth.com>
To: maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia.park@helixhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jun 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline check-in — proposed revised target

Maya / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick response. Procurement has confirmed the review queue and the earliest realistic PO window is the week of July 18, subject to no additional legal redlines. That pushes our target go-live to the week of July 25 at the earliest.

We are attaching the procurement hold document that summarizes outstanding SOW language and the indemnity language we need. We can accelerate if Redwood provides a clean SOW redline and a commitment to a set negotiation window (48 hours) once we respond.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345

Attachment: ProcurementHold.pdf

—Procurement Team

From: maya.srinivasan@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: leadership@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline check-in — MAP rebaseline and exec summary

Team —

Summary and proposed next steps after procurement update (thread above):

1) New external constraint: PO earliest week of 2027-07-18 (procurement note).
2) Proposed customer-facing MAP changes (I will share MAP-v3.xlsx to Alicia/Liam this afternoon):
   - Sandbox enablement: within 5 business days of PO 
   - Pilot window: 10 business days after sandbox with explicit acceptance checklist
   - Full go-live: target week of 2027-07-25 with fallback plan to phased acceptance if legal requests additional amendments
3) Internal asks (owners):
   - Karthik: prepare reserved capacity estimate and cost impact if we need to hold a slot past July 25 (due EOD 06/30).
   - Neha: draft UAT support roster and pre-UAT validation checklist (due EOD 07/01).
   - Finance: review potential retention fee schedule for reserved capacity and confirm approval threshold (I've CC'd leadership for visibility).
4) Escalation recommendation: if procurement extends beyond 3 more weeks (i.e., beyond 2027-08-08), we should route to Sales Director for decision on credit/contract terms and whether to offer a temporary discount to protect timeline.

I'll send MAP-v3 and the redlined SOW to Alicia/Liam shortly; I'll also populate the attached risk ledger with the current status and classification (hard blocker vs. mitigatable).

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Product: Inference Platform
[Attachment: MAP-v3.xlsx (Excel)]
